Usage: gwt config <command> [flags]

Inspect gwt's configuration.

Flags:
      --json    Print one JSON object instead of text.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help    Show context-sensitive help.

Commands:
  show    Print the effective configuration and the file each value came from.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed, or a creation was declined; remove and merged also exit 1 when any target failed,
       after printing every target's result
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run

Run "gwt config <command> --help" for a command's details.
